avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 24 to 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Blazed Alder
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: June 2 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Red Hill
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 13 (2023), June 12 (2024), June 3 (2025)

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 22 (2023), June 28 (2024), June 23 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Blazed Alder

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 24 and May 22, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Blazed Alder
evidence.detail: melted out April 20, 222 ft above the pass; points to March 24 to May 9

evidence.name: Red Hill
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 972 ft above the pass; points to April 3 to May 31

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 1,942 ft above the pass; points to March 11 to May 22
